content: In this section, we use the proposed method to create GreenBioBERT, an inexpensive and environmentally friendly alternative to BioBERT. Recall that BioBERTv1.0 (biobert_v1.0_pubmed_pmc) was initialized from general-domain BERT (bert-base-cased) and pretrained on PubMed+PMC.
